title: Commission starts enforcing AI Act rules and new transparency requirements on 2 August
notes: Primary official EU press release. Cited for the EU enforcement start date and transparency requirements under Social. Issues: Summary page linking to full press release; 180+ figure as stated.
claims: From 2 August 2026 the Commission AI Office + national authorities begin enforcing the AI Act
Transparency rules apply from 2 August 2026: chatbot disclosure, deepfake labelling, machine-readable marks on AI-generated/altered content
First list of more than 180 organisations signed the Code of Practice on transparency of AI-generated content
